scan_metadata.paper: Reimagining research papers as interactive and reliable AI agents
scan_metadata.explanation: Reduced scope: one PBMC 1k v3 input and preprocessing/clustering workflow for learning Paper2MCP.

tutorials.title: Preprocessing and clustering
tutorials.description: Scanpy workflow covering 10x HDF5 reading, QC, filtering, normalization, HVG selection, PCA, neighbors, UMAP and Leiden.
tutorials.reason_for_include_or_exclude: Directly matches the paper's Scanpy preprocessing and clustering scope; PBMC 1k v3 input substitutes for the notebook's example data and is recorded as a scope adaptation.

tool_review.limitations: Single-dataset reduced workflow; tutorial example data differs from paper PBMC dataset; package checkout currently shallow.
